data_provenance.outcome: One iff all retained ordinary raters report no minor/major/critical translation error for that segment
data_provenance.estimand: Unweighted finite mean of derived exact binary consensus scores on the fixed common annotated pool
data_provenance.scope: Recorded annotation consensus, not severity-weighted MQM or latent true human quality
data_provenance.parser: Literal tab splitting; exact known header/comment; reject unknown severities or malformed rows
data_provenance.exclusions: References/human outputs and segments with any HOTW-test/canary annotation; source issues and neutral opinions are not errors
